_comment: Non-secret access model for the lab. Tokens live ONLY in .env as MCP_TOKEN_<CALLER> (see .env.example). In production this comes from your IdP: tenant and scopes are claims in a signed JWT.

alice.description: Consumer self-service app for tenant A, read only

bob.description: Business portal for tenant B, read only

carol.description: Care agent for tenant A: may submit orders and see unmasked PII

mallory.description: Authenticated but granted no scopes: must see no tools
